name: ak-sales-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Alaska sales and use tax for 2026. Alaska has no statewide sales tax, but boroughs and cities levy their own, and the Alaska Remote Seller Sales Tax Commission (ARSSTC) collects for its member communities from remote sellers and marketplace facilitators.
